reference.pathophysiology: Fresh viable ischaemia under 14 days dissolves through catheters while fixed mottling goes to surgery; massive embolism takes systemic lysis where allowed with catheter rescue where banned, intracranial bleeding bans all lysis absolutely, and ATTRACT keeps DVT lysis selective.
